novelty: Exact multi-block forward algebraic-complexity audit after cancelling the shared-key feed-forward term; distinct from V25 statistical PNB/differentials, inverse low-degree relations, selectors, MITM and constant-factor screening.
scope: controlled reduced ChaCha only; target-free forward map structural falsifier
cancelled_difference: D_w(k)=(Z_w(k,257)-Z_w(k,1)-delta_feed_w) mod 2^32, where delta_feed is zero except known counter-word feed-forward delta
exact_method: For every output bit and key width build the complete 2^b truth table and apply exact GF(2) Möbius transform to obtain ANF coefficients. Record algebraic degree, monomial support count, and support exponent log2(max(1,support))/b.
stable_sparse_bit_rule: A bit is sparse-useful at width b iff degree<=6 and support exponent<=0.75. Stability requires the same bit position satisfy the rule at both b14 and b16 for the R6 cancelled-difference map.
secondary_control: Report identical metrics for R4 but R4 cannot rescue an R6 primary FAIL.
stage1_only_if_pass: Freeze a polynomial-solving experiment using only the stable bit positions, with monomial-generation/preprocessing/memory/verification billed in TOTAL and fresh b-width scaling. No alpha claim from Stage0 alone.
kill_rule: If any primary gate fails at R6, close this exact feed-forward-cancelled ANF family. Do not change counter pair, output-bit subset, degree threshold, support threshold or use a second development set.
forbidden: No target/output selection, approximate ANF, learned bit selection, PNB-style condition tuning or inverse-relation reinterpretation after results. No full-round claim.
